summary: OpenSSL: use after free in SSL_free_buffers
details:
Calling the OpenSSL API function SSL_free_buffers may cause memory to be
accessed that was previously freed in some situations. A use after free can
have a range of potential consequences such as the corruption of valid data,
crashes or execution of arbitrary code. However, only applications that
directly call the SSL_free_buffers function are affected. Fixed in OpenSSL
3.0.14; the pinned 3.0.13 is vulnerable.
